<div class="gallery-description max-w-2xl mx-auto mb-8 text-neutral-600 dark:text-neutral-400 tracking-wide">
&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;Discover the monumental architecture and unique atmosphere of Chicago. From the silver reflections of Cloud Gate in Millennium Park to the dizzying skyscrapers lining the river, immerse yourself in the energy of the Windy City.
</div>
